Description of Web-server The overall best performing models described in Table 6 are implemented in the form of a web-server GlycoPP available freely at http://www.imtech.res.in/raghava/glycopp/. The common gateway interface of GlycoPP is written using CGI/PERL script. This server allows for prediction of N- and O-glycosites in prokaryotic protein sequences.
